sentences.text: The Social Security Pension Scheme (SSPS) is a welfare initiative by the Government of India.
It aims to provide financial assistance to the elderly and disabled individuals.
The objective is to ensure a minimum level of financial security for vulnerable sections of society.
Eligible beneficiaries include senior citizens aged 60 years and above and persons with disabilities.
The scheme provides a monthly pension to eligible individuals.
The amount of pension varies by state and is subject to government guidelines.
The application process typically involves submitting a form along with necessary documents to the local government office.
The frequency of pension disbursement is monthly.
The implementing authorities for this scheme include state governments and local bodies.
The scheme is part of a broader effort to enhance social security for marginalized populations.
